subcommands.name: cancel-query
subcommands.description: Cancels a query that has been issued.

subcommands.name: create-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: Create a scheduled query that will be run on your behalf at the configured schedule.

subcommands.name: describe-account-settings
subcommands.description: Describes the settings for your account that include the query pricing model and the configured maximum TCUs the service can use for your query workload.

subcommands.name: describe-endpoints
subcommands.description: DescribeEndpoints returns a list of available endpoints to make Timestream API calls against.

subcommands.name: describe-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: Provides detailed information about a scheduled query.

subcommands.name: execute-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: You can use this API to run a scheduled query manually.

subcommands.name: list-scheduled-queries
subcommands.description: Gets a list of all scheduled queries in the caller's Amazon account and Region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all tags on a Timestream query resource.

subcommands.name: prepare-query
subcommands.description: A synchronous operation that allows you to submit a query with parameters to be stored by Timestream for later running.

subcommands.name: query
subcommands.description: Query is a synchronous operation that enables you to run a query against your Amazon Timestream data.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associate a set of tags with a Timestream resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association of tags from a Timestream query resource.

subcommands.name: update-account-settings
subcommands.description: Transitions your account to use TCUs for query pricing and modifies the maximum query compute units that you've configured.
